In Revenue Cloud / CPQ, what does a price rule act on?
Quote and quote line fields, at a defined calculation event
Price rules fire at a chosen calculator event (On Initialization, Before/On/After Calculate) and inject values into quote and quote line fields.
In CPQ, what does a product rule of type Validation do?
Stops the user saving a configuration that breaks the rule, with a message
Hides a product from the catalogue
Validation rules block an invalid configuration; Selection rules add, remove or hide options; Alert rules warn but let the user continue.
In CPQ, what is a bundle?
A parent product whose options are configured and sold together
A group of quotes for one account
A bundle is a parent product with product options (often in features), configured as one sale — a laptop with its warranty and accessories.
In Omni-Channel, what does a routing configuration primarily define?
Which agents exist in the queue
How work items are prioritised and how much capacity each consumes
Routing configurations set priority, routing model and the capacity weight of each work item. Presence configurations decide what an agent can accept.
What does an agent’s presence status tell Omni-Channel?
Whether the agent is available, and for which channels
How many cases the agent closed today
Presence statuses (“Available – Chat”, “Busy”) decide whether and what work Omni-Channel pushes to the agent.
What does an Experience Cloud "audience" control?
Which page variation or component a visitor sees
Audiences drive personalisation — page variations, branding sets, component visibility. They are not a security control; guest access is still governed by the guest user profile and sharing.
How do sharing sets give high-volume Experience Cloud users access to records?
By matching an account or contact on the user to a field on the record
By making the user the record owner
High-volume users have no role, so sharing sets grant access where, say, the record’s Account matches the user’s account.
Which Experience Cloud licence is meant for partners who sell with you, with access to leads and opportunities?
Partner Community includes leads, opportunities and roles for partner users; Customer Community is for customer self-service.
What does converting a lead create?
An account and a contact, and optionally an opportunity
Conversion creates (or matches) an account and contact and can create an opportunity; lead field mapping carries custom fields across.
What sets an opportunity’s default probability?
Each stage carries a default probability and a forecast category; changing the stage moves both.
What must a product have before it can be added to an opportunity?
An entry in the opportunity’s price book
Opportunity products come from price book entries, and every opportunity uses one price book.
How many quotes on an opportunity can be synced with it at a time?
One synced quote at a time: its line items and the opportunity products stay in step until another quote is synced.
In Enterprise Territory Management, what assigns accounts to territories automatically?
Account assignment rules on each territory match account fields — country, industry, size — and are run to place accounts.
Which opportunity field decides which forecast column an opportunity counts in?
Forecast category (Pipeline, Best Case, Commit, Closed) groups opportunities in the forecast; it defaults from the stage.
What is the standard daily limit on leads captured by Web-to-Lead?
500 per day; requests over that are queued and the admin is notified. Web-to-Case allows 5,000.
What is the standard daily limit on cases created by Web-to-Case?
5,000 per day — ten times the Web-to-Lead allowance.
How many case assignment rules can be active at once?
One active rule, with as many ordered entries as needed. The first entry that matches decides the owner.
What do escalation rules act on?
Cases not closed or updated within a set time
Leads that have not been converted
Users who have not logged in
Escalation rules reassign or notify when a case passes its age threshold, measured against business hours.
What do entitlements and milestones measure?
The service level a customer is owed, such as time to first response
An entitlement says what support a customer gets; milestones are its time-bound steps, tracked with warnings and violations.
What state must a Salesforce Knowledge article version be in for customers to see it?
Only published versions are visible on channels, and only on the channels the article is enabled for.
Salesforce processes the email itself, with no email agent installed behind your firewall
Cases are created only during business hours
On-Demand Email-to-Case uses Apex email services inside Salesforce; the older Email-to-Case needed an agent running on your own network.
What does a macro do in the Service Console?
Runs a recorded series of actions on a record in one click
Sends a survey after every case
Macros automate repetitive console steps — fill a field, choose an email template, send — so an agent does them in one click.
Before a product can be added to a custom price book, what must it have?
A price in the standard price book
The standard price book is the master list; custom price books can only offer products already priced there.
What do opportunity contact roles record?
Which contacts are involved in the deal, and in what role
Decision maker, influencer, economic buyer — and they are what campaign influence uses to connect campaigns to deals.
Campaigns to the opportunities they helped generate
It attributes opportunities to campaigns, typically through the contact roles of the people the campaign reached.
What does a campaign member status track?
Each lead or contact's response to the campaign, such as Sent or Responded
Statuses marked Responded feed the campaign's response counts.
What does a campaign hierarchy do?
Rolls up the results of child campaigns to their parent
A product launch can own its emails, events and webinars, and report on them together.
What happens to leads assigned to a queue?
The queue owns them until a member takes ownership
They are deleted after a day
Queues let a team share incoming work without assigning it to one person up front.
What does Path show on a record page?
A map of the account's location
The stages of a process, with key fields and guidance for each step
Path keeps a rep's attention on what matters at the current stage.
What does the Kanban view of opportunities let a rep do?
Kanban shows a list view as columns by a picklist such as stage, with totals per column.
When does a Big Deal Alert fire?
When an opportunity reaches set amount and probability thresholds
It emails the people named on the alert so a large deal is not discovered in the forecast meeting.
Sharing credit for an opportunity among team members
Splitting one opportunity into two records
Splits allocate revenue or overlay credit by percentage, and forecasts can use them.
Create a new opportunity per member
Give named users roles and access on a particular opportunity
Team members get the access the owner grants, beyond what sharing would give them.
What does the Parent Account field create?
An account hierarchy, such as a group and its subsidiaries
The hierarchy view shows how related companies fit together.
Accounts owned by one person only
Selling to individuals, combining account and contact in one record
They suit B2C models where the customer is a person rather than a company.
Once person accounts are enabled, can they be switched off?
Enabling them is permanent, which is why it is planned and tested in a sandbox first.
How are tasks and events linked to records?
Through a lookup on every object
Through the Name (WhoId) and Related To (WhatId) fields
Who points to a person (lead or contact); What points to a thing, such as an account or opportunity.
What does Einstein Activity Capture do?
Syncs emails and events from Gmail or Microsoft and links them to related records
It saves reps logging activity by hand; who can see the captured activity is set in its own sharing settings.
In Collaborative Forecasts, what can a manager do with a subordinate's forecast?
Adjust it, while the subordinate's own number is kept
Adjustments show the manager's judgement beside the rep's figure rather than overwriting it.
What do product schedules let you do?
Spread quantity or revenue over time, such as monthly instalments
Revenue and quantity schedules show when money or units arrive, not only how much.
What does a CPQ discount schedule provide?
Discounts that change with quantity or term
Volume tiers or slabs apply automatically as quantity changes on a quote line.
What do CPQ quote templates produce?
The quote document sent to the customer
Templates lay out sections, line items and terms, and generate the PDF.
A change to an active contract mid-term, such as adding licences, co-terminated with it
Amendments create a quote against the existing contract so the new items end when the contract does.
Where does a CPQ renewal quote come from?
The contract, through its renewal opportunity
Renewal forecasting and quoting work from the contract's subscriptions.
Splitting a case into several cases
Several people to work on a case, each with a defined role and access
Predefined case teams can be added by assignment rules or by hand.
How does the Service Console keep an agent's work together?
Every record opens in a new window
Only one record can be open
Related records open as subtabs inside the case's workspace tab
Workspace tabs and subtabs keep the case, its contact and its account side by side.
What do data categories do in Salesforce Knowledge?
Classify articles and control who can see them
Category visibility, set on roles, profiles or permission sets, decides which articles users can find.
On which channels can a Knowledge article be made available?
The internal app, customers, partners and a public knowledge base
Each article chooses its channels, so internal-only troubleshooting notes stay internal.
What is case deflection on a help site?
Showing relevant articles before a customer submits a case
A case avoided because the answer was already there is the cheapest one to handle.
What does skills-based routing in Omni-Channel do?
Sends work to the newest agent
Sends work to agents who have the skills it needs
Skills such as language or product are matched between the work item and the agent.
What does agent capacity in Omni-Channel limit?
How many cases they can close per day
How much work an agent is offered at once
Each work item consumes capacity, so three chats might fill a slot that one complex case would.
What does Messaging for In-App and Web let customers do?
Message agents or bots from a website or app, and pick the conversation up later
Edit their own cases in Setup
Messaging is asynchronous: the conversation persists, unlike a chat session that ends when the window closes.
What does Service Cloud Voice bring into the console?
Calls arrive alongside other channels in Omni-Channel, with the transcript on the record.
In Field Service, what is a service appointment?
The scheduled visit a mobile worker carries out
Work orders say what needs doing; service appointments say when and by whom.
In Field Service, what is a service resource?
A person or crew who can be scheduled to do work
Resources carry skills and territories that scheduling policies match against appointments.
The tool for designing the pages of an Experience Cloud site
Pages are built from components and templates; LWR sites use Lightning Web Components.
Who is a visitor who has not logged in to an Experience Cloud site, as far as the platform is concerned?
Every unauthenticated request runs as the guest user, so its profile and sharing rules are the public exposure.
How is content managed in Salesforce CMS?
In workspaces, then published to channels such as sites
Content is written once in a workspace and reused across the sites it is shared with.
What does self-registration on an Experience Cloud site create?
An external user, with a contact on an account
The registration handler decides which account new contacts are placed under and which licence they get.
Which licence adds roles and sharing rules for customer users?
Customer Community users get access through sharing sets; Plus adds roles and sharing rules, and reports.
How is a login-based Experience Cloud licence counted?
Suited to large numbers of occasional users; a member-based licence suits frequent ones.
The timeline of milestones a case must meet
It applies milestones, such as first response and resolution, with warning and violation actions.
